EXISTENCE/SPEC: found SNGPL's own 'Province-Wise Transmission Breakup' table (Transmission System section of sngpl.com.pk, FY2025 data as of 30-Jun-2025), which lists a discrete line 'N2 - SAHIWAL (RLNG LINE) | 24 [in] | 77.296 [km]' -- an exact match to GEM's Diameter=24in and LengthKnown=77.30km (77.296 rounds to 77.30; immaterial). The same table separately lists 'AV29 - N2 (RLNG LINE) | 24 | 68.16' (matches GEM's P4099 exactly) and 'AV29 - SAHIWAL | 36 | 145.46' (matches GEM's P4105 exactly). DUPLICATE CHECK: I noticed 68.16 + 77.296 = 145.456 ~= P4105's 145.46 km and initially suspected P4100+P4099 might be a double-count of the same corridor as P4105 (same AV29<->Sahiwal endpoints). SNGPL's own table resolves this: all three lines are listed as separate, named assets -- AV29-N2 and N2-Sahiwal are a chained pair of 24in RLNG lines, while AV29-Sahiwal is a distinct, larger 36in line covering the same corridor end-to-end (i.e. a parallel/looped higher-capacity line, not a re-segmentation of the same pipe). Verdict: NOT a duplicate -- ruled out against the primary source, not just against the roster. CLASSIFICATION: 'RLNG LINE' in SNGPL's own Transmission System table confirms PipelineType=transmission and Fuel=Gas (RLNG = regasified LNG, i.e. natural gas post-regasification) are both correct; this is not a gathering/feeder line. ATTRIBUTION: the line appears in SNGPL's own asset inventory, directly supporting Owner1=SNGPL 100%. LOCATION: SNGPL's table names the segment 'N2-Sahiwal' but does not spell out that node N2 = 'Mian Channu' -- GEM's StartLocation='Mian Channu' is internally consistent with P4099's EndLocation='Mian Channu' (the AV29-N2 segment terminates where N2-Sahiwal begins), which is chain logic internal to GEM's own data, not an independently-confirmed place-to-node mapping. As a second, genuinely independent source I checked the Route [ref] already on the sheet: a 2020 'Energy Infrastructure Map' published by Pakistan Petroleum Information Service / Directorate General of Petroleum Concessions (hosted at pepl.com.pk, a body distinct from SNGPL). Its OCR/text layer places 'MIAN CHANNUN' and 'SAHIWAL' in the same regional cluster alongside labeled RLNG infrastructure and RLNG-fired power plants (BHIKKI, BALLOKI-RLNG) -- independent corroboration that an RLNG pipeline corridor through Mian Channu-Sahiwal is real, though this national-scale map does not carry the granular 77.296km/24in figure itself. Note: url_verifier.py FAILed this pepl.com.pk URL with an SSLError (cert-chain issue) -- this is the documented false-negative pattern in the verifier's own help text ('SSL cert-chain errors ... confirm via curl/Wayback'); I manually confirmed HTTP 200 via `curl -sk` and confirmed 'Sahiwal' and 'Mian Channu' ('MIAN CHANNUN') both appear in the extracted PDF text (pdftotext -layout), so I am citing it per that documented override, not blindly. NET: existence + classification + non-duplicate status are corroborated by two independent sources; the exact length/diameter figure rests on one strong, current, official primary source (SNGPL's own published network table) -- hence tier=medium rather than high, and I'm flagging that as the one lingering caveat rather than a concern.

summary: P4100 (N2-Sahiwal RLNG Pipeline) is real and correctly classified: SNGPL's own current (FY2025) transmission-network table lists 'N2-SAHIWAL (RLNG LINE), 24in, 77.296km' -- an exact match to GEM's Length/Diameter, confirming Status/Fuel/PipelineType/Owner by context; a suspected duplicate with P4105 (AV29-Sahiwal, 145.46km = 68.16+77.30) was checked and ruled out, since SNGPL's table lists all three (AV29-N2, N2-Sahiwal, AV29-Sahiwal) as separate real lines, the latter being a larger parallel 36in line over the same corridor, not a re-segmentation. Verdict: confirmed (caveat) -- the exact length/diameter figure rests on one strong primary source (tier=medium); no UNRESOLVED items.
